feature_notes: Adds checked buffered scalar/SST decoding and direct plain shared-text ownership, improving complete native and Python reads against A7 on verified numeric/text workloads. Packed model reservations now charge retained capacity and preflight growth: an explicit 64 MiB allowance supports one million numeric cells instead of 262,143, and 384 MiB permits a verified million-cell row insertion. Removes arbitrary default cell/sheet count caps while retaining explicit byte/count controls and legal coordinates. Descending insertion reduces million-cell model RSS about 68%; guarded shrinking preserves deletion and finite-bank behavior. Conservative Linux Auto cache credit and byte-oriented XML escaping retain canonical validation and exact output. Serial reports expose mixed small timings, about 4-5% per-cell creation overhead, temporary storage, rejected prototypes and remaining opportunities; no universal speed/RAM superiority or NYC/dataframe result is claimed. Full M4 feature-graph dependencies and M5/M6 remain open.
